name: four-alike
description: Four Alike, a portrait card puzzle built with Godot for Google Play.

scripts.test: npm run -s check:generated && npm run -s check:levels && python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 tools/check_native.py && python3 tools/check.py
scripts.check:generated: python3 tools/content/build_content.py --check && python3 tools/art/build_candy_pop.py --check && python3 tools/audio/build_sfx.py --check && python3 tools/art/build_store_art.py --check
